text.p: NatWest Securities analyst Nicola Stewart clarified a downgrading on EMI Group Plc whose shares traded 6p lower at 1,094p by 1130 GMT on Wednesday.
Stewart cut her 1997/98 pre-tax profit forecast by 14 percent to 364 million stg from 414 million and for 1998/99 by nine percent to 410 million from 449 million.
Stewart said she was downgrading her figures as a preview to next Monday's share buy-back, which the company announced in May.
She cut her earnings per share forecasts by three percent for the current year to 27.6p per share and by two percent for 1998/99 to 31.1p per share.
The downgrading for the current year also took into account a five million stg cut in Stewart's estimates for operational profits due to lacklustre market conditions, she said.
"The dilution is not caused by the buy-back. It's a combination of a trimming of our operating profit numbers and the impact of the acquisition of a Motown publishing company," she said.
